title: Gherkin: console Now-panel Standup drawer + API
description:
## Spec-first

Authoritative Gherkin scenarios for Console standup embedded in the Now panel.

## Scenarios to cover

- Now panel exposes a Standup control (button) without adding Reports navigation.
- Opening the control shows a standup drawer anchored to CurrentStatusPanel.
- Drawer supports profile selection (meeting-script, director-brief) consistent with CLI standup.
- Drawer triggers standup generation via Console API (POST /api/standup).
- Loading, success, and fail-closed error states when right-now summaries are missing or generation fails.
- Drawer can be dismissed without leaving the Now panel view.

## Tags

- `@console` / `@console-server` as appropriate for kbsc-backed scenarios.
- No `@wip` when scenarios are ready for implementation.

## Parity

Python behave and Rust cucumber step definitions must stay in sync (`tools/check_spec_parity.py`).

comments.text: Closing: Console Standup Now-panel drawer/API shipped via PR #249/#251 (and follow-up #254/#258).

right_now_summary: Console Standup now works in the Now panel with profile selection, API generation, and safe error handling.
